visual_elements.description: Neural network architecture diagram with three rows of neurons. Leftmost purple input dots connect to first layer of circles containing Σ and σ. Three processing columns labeled Net_i, Net_j, Net_k with blue weight labels w_ji and w_kj between them. Red synaptic connections between layers. Output column on right connects to Output 1, Output 2, Output m. Vertical dark red bar labeled 'Error Error' with green Class 1, Class 2, Class m boxes to its right. Green arrow points from error bar toward middle output row.
Black rectangular label 'I/P Layer' with white text
Black rectangular label 'O/P Layer' with white text
Long black rectangular bar 'Hidden Layer(s)' with white text and bidirectional arrow
Light blue box 'Previous Layer Layer (i)' with up arrow
Light green box 'Current Layer (You are here)' with up arrow
Light orange box 'Next Layer Layer (K)' with up arrow
Vertical dark red bar with white vertical text 'Error Error'

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is large, bold, dark red, centered. Body text is smaller black sans-serif. Layer boxes use mixed case with parentheses. 'Current Layer (You are here)' includes parenthetical emphasis. Slide number in circle is small.
animation_state: No visible animation; appears to be a static complete slide.
recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to light gray (#f0f0f0).
2. Add title 'Neural Network Model' centered at top in large bold dark red sans-serif (#c0392b).
3. Add slide number '28' in a circle at top right.
4. Add 'Input Sample' in purple rounded rectangle top left with dashed arrow pointing right into diagram.
5. Add 'Target Label' in purple rounded rectangle top right with dashed arrow pointing left from diagram.
6. Draw neural network diagram in center: three rows of neurons with Σ and σ inside circles; columns labeled Net_i, Net_j, Net_k; blue weight labels w_ji and w_kj; red connections; output neurons on right labeled Output 1, Output 2, Output m.
7. Add purple dots on far left as input nodes.
8. Add bottom annotation boxes: 'Previous Layer Layer (i)' (light blue), 'Current Layer (You are here)' (light green), 'Next Layer Layer (K)' (light orange), each with upward arrow to corresponding column.
9. Add black bar 'Hidden Layer(s)' with left-right arrow spanning bottom center.
10. Add black boxes 'I/P Layer' bottom left and 'O/P Layer' bottom right.
11. Add vertical dark red bar on right labeled 'Error Error' in white vertical text.
12. Add green boxes 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m' to right of red bar.
13. Add green arrow from red bar pointing left toward middle output row.
